verses.text: Back then, Israel had no king. A Levite living in Ephraim’s remote hill country took a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah. 🌿
She was unfaithful to him and left for her father’s home in Bethlehem. She stayed there four months. 😔
Then her husband went after her to speak kindly and bring her back. He took his servant and two donkeys. When her father saw him, he was glad to welcome him. 🫏
His father-in-law—the young woman’s father—kept him there for three days. They ate, drank, and stayed the nights. 🍽️
Early on the fourth day, they got up to leave. The young woman’s father told his son-in-law, ‘Have a bite of bread to get your strength up, then you can go.’ 🍞
So the two of them sat down together to eat and drink. Then the father said, ‘Please stay the night and relax.’ 🍷
The man got up to leave, but his father-in-law kept urging him, so he stayed another night. 🏠
Early on the fifth day, he got up to go. The young woman’s father said, ‘Please eat something and stay until later.’ So they ate together. 🌅

When the man got up to leave with his concubine and servant, her father said, ‘Look, it’s getting late. Please stay the night; the day’s nearly done. Relax here, then get up early tomorrow and head home.’ 🌇
But the man wouldn’t stay that night. He set out and reached Jebus—now called Jerusalem—with his concubine and two saddled donkeys. 🧭
They were near Jebus, and the day was almost over. The servant said, ‘Let’s go into this Jebusite city and stay the night.’ 🌆
His master said, ‘We won’t go into a foreign city whose people aren’t Israelites. We’ll keep going to Gibeah.’ 🚶
He told his servant, ‘Come on, let’s reach one of those places. We can stay in Gibeah or Ramah.’ 🧭
So they kept traveling, and the sun went down as they came near Gibeah in Benjamin’s territory. 🌄
They turned aside to stay in Gibeah. The man went into the city square and sat there, but nobody invited them home for the night. 🏙️
Then an old man came in from his fieldwork at evening. He was from Ephraim’s hill country but lived in Gibeah, where the people were Benjamites. 🌙
He looked up and saw the traveler sitting in the city square. The old man asked, ‘Where are you headed? Where did you come from?’ 👀

The traveler replied, ‘We’re going from Bethlehem in Judah to the far side of Ephraim’s hill country. That’s where I’m from. I went to Bethlehem, and now I’m headed to Yahweh’s house. But no one has taken us in for the night. 🗣️
‘We have straw and feed for our donkeys, and bread and wine for me, your female servant, and the young man with us. We have everything we need.’ 🍞
The old man said, ‘Peace to you. I’ll take care of what you need. Just don’t spend the night out in the square.’ 🕊️
He brought them into his house and fed the donkeys. They washed their feet, then ate and drank. 🏠

While they were relaxing, some wicked men from the city surrounded the house and hammered on the door. They shouted to the old man, ‘Bring out the man staying with you. We want to have sex with him!’ 🚪
The homeowner went out and said, ‘No, my brothers, don’t do this evil thing. This man is my guest. Don’t commit this outrage. 🛑
‘Look, my virgin daughter and his concubine are here. I’ll bring them out. Humiliate them and do whatever you want to them, but don’t do this evil thing to the man.’ ⚠️
But the men refused to listen. So the man grabbed his concubine and pushed her outside to them. They raped and abused her through the night until morning. At daybreak, they let her go. 💔
At dawn, the woman came back and collapsed at the entrance of the man’s house where her husband was, lying there until daylight. 🌅
In the morning, her husband got up and opened the house doors to continue his journey. There she was—his concubine, collapsed at the entrance with her hands on the threshold. 😔
He said, ‘Get up. Let’s go.’ But she didn’t answer. He lifted her onto the donkey, and the man went home. 🫏
When he reached home, he took a knife, cut his concubine’s body into twelve pieces, and sent them throughout Israel’s territory. ⚠️
Everyone who saw it said, ‘Nothing like this has ever happened or been seen since Israel came up from Egypt until today. Think it over, take counsel, and tell us what to do.’ 📣
